title: Roselle Refresh Polish Deck
brands: A light polish of today's roselle tea and pouch, not a redesign: same kraft pouch, cream label, dusty rose wash and circular WellNest logo. Blend today: organic roselle, grown and handmade on our family organic farm.
WellNest Teas: Three Projects, Project 3: Roselle Refresh; R107 refresh (Max via WellNest, Oct 17 2026 20:04 ICT), built on the mockups (Max 20:09 ICT).
format_note: Every pick: A = Our Pick (draft, confirm), B = a sensible swap from the source. From Your Swipes items are settled and not asked.
flags_unconfirmed: Thai name กระเจี๊ยบ and 'caffeine free' stay off until confirmed.
